title: Joint urea–total-CO2 encoding for independent-cycle albuminuria prediction
abstract: Adding a sex-specific BUN–total-CO2 tensor spline changed independent-cycle weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.793547 to 0.834649 (delta +0.041102; joint PSU-bootstrap95% [+0.008974,+0.223891]). The registered improvement criterion was not met. Exploratory cross-cycle prediction, not untouched confirmation or evidence of causality.
